links.outcome: Clinician cognitive workload (NASA-TLX) with interpretable AI copilot versus comparator condition
links.effect: Reduced cognitive workload reported with AICare; qualitative analysis showed trust built through verification. No numeric results in the abstract.
links.quote: Our findings indicate AICare's reduced cognitive workload.

unlisted_practices: Interactive, interpretable AI copilot with scrutable visualizations to support clinician verification of AI reasoning

screen.reason: Empirical within-subjects user study with 16 clinicians testing how an interactive, interpretable AI copilot (visualization/grounded recommendations) impacts decision-making, cognitive workload, and trust verification.
